description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring slender soft trunk capped by two opposing arcs of long grasping head spines.
description.zh: 拟议形态研究：细长软躯干头部具两列相对弧形长抓握棘。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning study grounded in a named taxon source; reconstructed or simplified components remain artistic interpretations.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据具名分类单元来源进行属级规划；补全及简化结构仍属于复原或美术解释。

distinctness.en: A distinct construction based on slender soft trunk capped by two opposing arcs of long grasping head spines; not a size, color or posture variant.
distinctness.zh: 以细长软躯干头部具两列相对弧形长抓握棘建立独立几何结构，而非尺寸、配色或姿势变体。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish slender soft trunk capped by two opposing arcs of long grasping head spines; emphasize the largest gaps and changes in contour. Simplify fine repeated surfaces; do not copy source geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先搭建细长软躯干头部具两列相对弧形长抓握棘，突出主要间隙和轮廓变化，简化细小重复表面，不复制来源网格。

uncertainty: Named source supports the principal form. Species-level dimensions, missing structures and soft tissues still require a selected specimen reference.
reference_notes: Named concept revised during taxonomic and silhouette review. No exact coexistence is implied.

sources.title: Capinatator praetermissus: a prehistoric sea creature with spines to spare
sources.supports: Capinatator body and two opposing arrays of head spines based on Burgess Shale specimens; original artwork is copyrighted.
